name: M-26-14 DM: Data Retirement — Gate 2 Deletion Approval Pending
description: Detects M-26-14 managed indices awaiting Gate 2 (deletion authorization) in the two-gate data retirement chain. Fires when the newest pending_gate2 record for an index is more than 24 hours old and no approved_gate2, scheduled_for_deletion, cancelled or deletion_completed record for the same index is newer than it (latest-record semantics over an append-only ledger). Gate 2 is the last human checkpoint before deletion; the compliance snapshot is taken after approval, when ILM advances to the delete phase behind wait_for_snapshot. The 90-day lookback (on event.ingested, stamped by the ledger pipeline) covers the realistic pending horizon.
author: Elastic
query: FROM m_26_14-retirement-requests | WHERE index_name IS NOT NULL AND state IN ("pending_gate2", "approved_gate2", "scheduled_for_deletion", "cancelled", "deletion_completed") | EVAL ts = COALESCE(updated_at, created_at, @timestamp) | STATS pending_created = MAX(CASE(state == "pending_gate2", COALESCE(created_at, ts), NULL)), last_resolution = MAX(CASE(state IN ("approved_gate2", "scheduled_for_deletion", "cancelled", "deletion_completed"), ts, NULL)), last_updated = MAX(ts), gate1_approvers = VALUES(gate1_approved_by), ilm_policies = VALUES(ilm_policy), request_ids = VALUES(request_id) BY index_name | WHERE pending_created IS NOT NULL AND (last_resolution IS NULL OR last_resolution < pending_created) AND DATE_DIFF("hours", pending_created, NOW()) > 24 | EVAL pending_hours = DATE_DIFF("hours", pending_created, NOW()) | SORT pending_created ASC
note:
## Triage and Investigation

### Step 1 — Verify snapshot readiness (not a per-index snapshot)
- The compliance snapshot for this index does NOT exist yet at Gate 2 review time: it is created after approval, when ILM advances to the delete phase and `wait_for_snapshot` blocks deletion until the SLM policy completes successfully. That ILM step is the machine-enforced prerequisite.
- What reviewers verify pre-approval is that the snapshot machinery is healthy: `GET _slm/policy/m_26_14-readiness-snapshots` (or the configured policy) shows recent successful runs, and `GET _slm/status` is RUNNING.
- If SLM is unhealthy or the policy's last run failed, fix that before approving - otherwise the index will sit in the ILM delete phase waiting on `wait_for_snapshot` indefinitely.

### Step 2 — Confirm no active legal holds
- Query `m_26_14-retirement-requests` for `legal_hold_initiated` records whose `source_index` names the same data stream or matches the backing index (ILM mount prefixes `partial-`/`restored-` do not count). The Gate 2 watcher applies the same guard mechanically and skips a held index.
- Verify with legal/compliance that no ongoing investigations require this data.

### Step 3 — Authorize deletion (Gate 2)
- A second, different person approves Gate 2 with ONE new record: `POST m_26_14-retirement-requests/_doc {"request_id": "<index>-gate2-approved-<now-iso>", "index_name": "<name exactly as listed>", "state": "approved_gate2", "gate2_approved_by": "<your-username>", "gate2_approved_at": "<now-iso>"}` (the ledger pipeline stamps `@timestamp`, `updated_at`, `event.ingested`)
- The Gate 2 Execution Watcher (`m_26_14-gate2-execute-deletion`) will detect this within 1 hour and switch the index to its deletion-enabled ILM policy (the delete phase then waits on wait_for_snapshot).

### Step 4 — Post-deletion verification
- On approval the watcher writes a `scheduled_for_deletion` record and switches the index to its delete-enabled ILM policy; ILM then waits for the snapshot and deletes. Runbook: `docs/runbooks/data-retirement.md`.
- Verify index is no longer present: `GET _cat/indices/<index_name>`
- The compliance snapshot will be retained in `found-snapshots` per the m_26_14-readiness-snapshots SLM policy (7-year retention).
setup:
### Supersession semantics
This rule groups all workflow records by `index_name` and alerts only when a pending record exists with no superseding state for the same index. Approvals and cancellations indexed as new documents (per the approval instructions above) therefore clear the alert condition without needing to update the original pending document in place.
